Title: Iris
Citation: Fisher, R. (1936). Iris [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C56C76.
Transformations: File renamed from iris.data to iris.csv; bytes unchanged.
Interpretation: Column names and centimetre units assigned from the UCI metadata; each row is one plant record.
SourceCaveat: UCI documents differences from the measurements in Fisher's historical article. This copy retains the distributed values without correction.
